name: Grape Nut Ice Cream
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical no-churn ice cream recipes with ~3.5 cups total volume yielding 4 moderate servings
Minutes based on ~10 min active prep plus minimum 6 hr (360 min) freezing time
Heavy Cream classified as dairy/milk allergen source
Grape Nut Cereal classified as containing wheat (from wheat flour in standard recipe)
Condensed Milk classified as dairy/milk allergen source
No eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, or sesame listed or implied
Vanilla extract assumed alcohol-based, not soy-derived
No barley/rye listed but wheat present so not gluten-free
Recipe contains dairy so not vegan or dairy-free; compatible with vegetarian and pescatarian
instructions:
In a large bowl, use an electric mixer to whip the cold heavy cream until stiff peaks form. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk and vanilla extract until well combined.
Fold in the cereal and stir until evenly distributed throughout the mixture.
Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe container (such as a loaf pan). Lay plastic wrap on top of the ice cream to avoid freezer burn. Cover the container and freeze for at least 6 hours or until solid.
Once frozen, let the ice cream sit at room temperature for a few minutes to soften slightly before scooping and serving.

ingredients.name: Heavy Cream
ingredients.assumptions: Standard heavy whipping cream; 1 cup = 238 g; used full fat values for whipped state.

ingredients.name: Condensed Milk
ingredients.assumptions: Sweetened condensed milk; 1 1/4 oz (weight) assumed as 35 g; typical sweetened condensed milk nutrition.

ingredients.name: Vanilla Extract
ingredients.assumptions: Pure vanilla extract; 1 tsp ≈ 5 g; alcohol and sugar content reflected in carbs/calories.

ingredients.name: Grape Nut Cereal
ingredients.assumptions: Grape-Nuts cereal; 1 cup ≈ 120 g based on typical density; values for standard Post Grape-Nuts.
